summary.text: Lisa Klein is the Democratic candidate for the Florida House of Representatives, District 73, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces incumbent Republican Fiona McFarland.
Klein describes herself as a licensed mental health counselor, former public school educator and small business owner in Sarasota County.

paragraphs.text: Lisa Klein earned a high school diploma from Centennial High School, a bachelor's degree from the University of Central Florida in 2011 and a graduate degree from Wake Forest University in 2018, according to Ballotpedia.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she owns and operates a private clinical practice in Sarasota County and has also supported patients at Sarasota Memorial Hospital and taught in the classroom.

Klein's 2026 survey responses name affordability of housing, property insurance and health care, access to health care including mental health care, and full funding of public education as key messages.
She said she is passionate about civil rights and disability rights.
